title: Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer for Curve 143a1 — Hasse and Rank Formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Hasse-bound, analytic-rank, and Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer formalization for Cremona elliptic curve 143a1 of conductor 143. This repository is part of David Fox's Opera Numerorum ensemble.
